schedules.description: A synchronous cached snapshot is observed before selection returns.
A microtask cached snapshot is observed once.
After the first snapshot, every ordinary active delta still renders and reports once.
An active delayed decode records history, paints rows, and reports the count after completion.
A decode accepted before hiding records history after completion without visible output.
A decode accepted before switching records history but cannot publish into the next feed.
The identical feed object reopened in a new visit does not revive its old decoded frame.
After reopening the same feed, fresh deltas remain live while the previous decode stays retired.
An active layout Promise postpones its required count until completion.
A count waiting for layout is suppressed after hide while its already-committed rows and history remain.
A count waiting for old layout cannot publish after another feed becomes active.
An identical feed object in a new visit cannot revive a count waiting on the old visit layout.
Fresh same-feed work remains live after reopening while old layout feedback stays retired.
Rendering synchronously hides during deferred startup, invalidating count after the host returns.
Rendering synchronously selects another feed during deferred startup; new subscription stays usable.
Synchronous startup rendering hides before subscribe returns; the retired listener must still detach.
Synchronous startup rendering selects another feed; outer subscribe cannot overwrite newer cleanup.
Synchronous startup rendering hides and reopens the identical feed: exactly two accepted snapshots, only the new count.
Accepted decodes complete in reverse order after retirement and record exactly once; detached future events are ignored.
The independent metrics consumer retains a complete delta policy or the separately granted snapshot-plus-delta policy.
Closing one workspace does not retire a separate workspace or suppress its live count.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Cached first delivery moves from synchronous startup to a microtask.
expected_changed_effects: Both observe exactly one first frame; only synchronous startup must finish inline.
History remains while rows and count disappear.
New feed remains live without old visible output.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Retirement is followed by reusing the same feed object.
expected_changed_effects: New snapshot remains live without reviving old decode.
Fresh rows, history, and count must still appear.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Retirement occurs between row commit and layout completion.
Retirement activates a different feed while old layout is pending.
expected_changed_effects: New feed count appears; old count remains absent.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Retirement reuses the same feed while old layout is pending.
expected_changed_effects: New visit count appears; old count remains absent.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Fresh delta follows retirement of an old layout.
The paint adapter hides synchronously before returning.
expected_changed_effects: Old count is suppressed at the host return boundary.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The first snapshot is delivered before subscribe returns.
Nested navigation now occurs before outer subscribe returns.
expected_changed_effects: Nested feed subscription remains owned and cleanable.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Nested selection reuses the identical feed instead of another object.
expected_changed_effects: Exactly two snapshots are accepted without duplicate old-listener history.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Add ordinary active deltas after the cached snapshot.
expected_changed_effects: Each later delta adds one row, count and history effect.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Two already-accepted delta decodes finish after retirement while one additional delta is emitted after detachment.
expected_changed_effects: Both accepted frames remain in history; the detached new frame creates no effects.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The same cached snapshot is observed by the panel consumer or the independent metrics consumer.
expected_changed_effects: Panel observes bootstrap; ungranted metrics retains delta-only policy.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: An independent workspace remains active while another workspace retires.
expected_changed_effects: Retiring the other workspace does not revoke active delta processing.
